intro: Reception from Tyrande is an Alliance quest that sends adventurers from the embattled slopes of the Stonetalon Mountains directly to the night elf capital of Darnassus. After aiding the Sentinels in securing their precarious foothold in Stonetalon against the Venture Company, you are sent by Sentinel Thenysil in Astranaar to receive formal recognition from High Priestess Tyrande Whisperwind herself in the Temple of the Moon.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Friend, I am sure Tyrande Whisperwind herself would like to thank you for taking part in this mission.
It may not appear so on the surface, but what you've helped start could very well strengthen our foothold in the Stonetalon Mountains.
If you consider yourself our ally against these atrocities, go see Tyrande in the Temple of the Moon in Darnassus.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Hello, friend. I have indeed heard your name before, and although you are still full of youth, I am pleased to see the path you have set for yourself.
You would do me a great honor if you would accept this as a gift of appreciation.
